verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe realtime transcription over WebSockets (Scribe v2 Realtime, under 150 ms latency), list WebSocket support alongside HTTP with official SDKs, and document voice activity detection for live processing. The evidence is vendor-only and stays at overview level. missing for 10: documented WebSocket message protocol details (partial vs final transcript events, audio format specs), independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time streaming.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time

citations.quote: Learn how to transcribe audio with ElevenLabs in realtime with WebSockets.
Scribe v2 Realtime captures live speech in under 150 ms with exceptional accuracy
HTTP and WebSocket support, official Python and Node.js SDKs.
Automatically detect when speech starts and stops, segmenting speech with precision for smoother live processing.
